rows.ARS:
Orange-pink Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: SA Garden/Tuin
rows.Origin:
Bred by Ludwig Taschner (South Africa, before 2011).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2011 as 'SA Garden/Tuin'.
rows.Bloom: Champagne orange, blushing pink. Strong, fruity fragrance. Double (17-25 petals), cupped, globular bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
